title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
写在最前面：前期校园，但架得很空，不谈学习，总体【慢热】+【装B】+【玛丽苏】+【不现实】；单向暗恋，有狗血，情节俗套无脑无逻辑bug齐飞，对文笔和剧情有要求的不建议看。-放学前最后一节课，夕阳笼罩整个学校，操场上至少有二十几个班级在上体育课。羽毛球拍和网球球拍挥动时惊动树间的鸟群，燕子麻雀扑棱着飞腾起来，在半空绕个圈，又纷纷降落原位，不肯归巢。池嘉寒行色匆匆往前跑，omega体力稍弱，疾跑穿过半个操场后就忍不住开始大口喘气。到了器材室门口，他一把推上去，虚掩的门朝里旋转，一股橡胶和石灰粉的味道扑面而来。器材室很宽敞，尽头高窗下，alpha正拿着笔坐在一块军绿色软垫上，膝上叠着几本书。窗外的余晖斜斜投在他身上，照出一双手臂上成片的乌青。alpha抬起头，看着池嘉寒走到自己面前。“就知道你在这儿。”池嘉寒喘着气，在看见对方肿起的右脸和嘴角的紫红淤血时，他紧拧起眉，“不都是周五打的吗，昨天才星期四，提前了？”“嗯。”alpha简短地应一声，又低下头看书。“许则。”池嘉寒沉声叫他。许则顿了顿，这才把书放到一边，伸手拉起校服下摆，露出右侧肋骨上一块贴着纱布的部位，语气平淡：“就这里，没别的伤了。”纱布贴得很粗糙，杂乱不平整，一看就是出自他自己之手，潦草到不行。池嘉寒蹲下去，轻扯着纱布一角，拉开，隐约看见里面密密麻麻的小伤口，已经结成一粒粒血痂，乱七八糟地和纱布凝固在一起，很符合许则的一贯作风——简单粗暴地把纱布往伤口上摁，好像不在乎换药时扯下来会有多痛。“碎玻璃？”池嘉寒蹙着眉问。许则没有正面回答，只说：“他们喜欢看。”“他们还喜欢看空手接白刃，你要不试试？”“刀具不能带上台。”许则有点认真地答道，顺手把衣摆放下去。池嘉寒往后坐在地上，冷冷瞪他半晌，才说：“放学去医院。”“没事，涂点碘伏就可以。”说话间，许则把书整理好。下课铃响了，许则站起身，动作牵扯到伤口，他轻微皱了皱眉。他朝池嘉寒伸出手，却被omega负气地挡开，池嘉寒自己站起来，拍拍裤子上的灰尘。两人走出器材室，天气预报说晚上会下雨，现在的风已经有点凉。上了三楼，两栋教学楼之间的天桥上人来人往，走到一半，许则忽然扭过头，看向栏杆外。风更大了，迎面走来几个alpha，其中一个尤其高些，面容冷淡，正垂眼看手机，但莫名的——哪怕低着头也能让人一眼就注意到他。他身旁的alpha和池嘉寒认识，抬手打了个招呼：“嘉寒。”池嘉寒朝他挥挥手，当是回应。招呼很简短，但alpha们的聊天还是因此被打断了几秒，其余人纷纷看向池嘉寒和许则这边，连同那个正在看手机的alpha，也抬起了头。从他们的角度看过去，许则比池嘉寒高半个头，正侧着脸朝向另一边。风吹起他额前的发，许则脸上没什么表情，显得有些冷漠阴郁，但手臂上的淤青很是扎眼，短袖校服完全挡不住。互相擦肩而过，alpha轻轻撞了下身边只抬头看了一眼就又把视线移回手机屏幕上的人，说：“赫扬，嘉寒旁边那个alpha，许则，信息素等级也是s。”陆赫扬关了手机放进校裤口袋里，他刚刚其实并没有看清什么，只是象征性抬一眼而已。不过他还是笑了笑，说：“是吗。”

Alpha们在身后走远，许则仍保持着往右看的姿势，实际上他的目光一直是空的，没有具体的落脚点，但他现在想回头看一眼——这个念头很快被打住。许则转回头重新看向正前方，将自己肿起的右脸和青紫的嘴角平静地暴露在每一个迎面而来的人的视线里。校门口，陆赫扬和其他几个alpha道了别，站在路边树下。两分钟后，一辆通体漆黑内饰全粉的敞篷跑车干脆利落地刹在他面前，驾驶座上穿T恤戴墨镜仿佛正从热带度假回来的alpha朝他吹了声口哨：“陆公子，好久不见。”“超过一周无故旷课，会被退学。”陆赫扬垂眼微微歪着头，提醒他。贺蔚摘下墨镜扔到中控台上，弯起一双桃花眼，笑得玩世不恭：“那可太好了。”副驾驶车门缓缓抬起，陆赫扬坐进去，系上安全带。他和贺蔚一样，16岁一到年龄就考了驾照，但陆赫扬对开车上学没什么兴趣，贺蔚曾评价他有这种想法是因为太过依赖家里的司机。正值放学时间，路上挤，贺蔚慢悠悠开着车，瞥了眼陆赫扬腕上的手环，轻啧一声：“预备校的学生放学了也不能摘手环吗？”Alpha的手环、omega的颈环，能够根据档位抑制与隔绝信息素。预备校的校规之一是在校期间必须佩戴，以防信息素相互冲突，因此难免会在一定程度上使得AO们感到被压制与禁锢的不适。“去哪。”陆赫扬不答反问。“先吃个饭。”车子驶过校门，贺蔚看向那块气派的巨大白石雕校牌，叹了口气，“听说读预备校就跟坐牢一样。”“还好。”陆赫扬调整了手环档位，适当释放出信息素，接着整个人往后陷进座椅里，闭上眼，“看你自觉。”反正对贺蔚来说，不管在哪里读书都像坐牢。“那我还是等退学通知好了。”贺蔚说。陆赫扬却笑：“你下周一应该会被押着来学校。”预备校致力于为联盟培养顶尖军事、政经、医学人才，进校的基础条件是信息素等级达到A级及以上，并且需要通过特定的书面和体能考核。全校初中部加高中部共三万多人，其中信息素为s级的学生数量只有两百左右。经过一代代的筛选与沉淀，高等级信息素后代们基本集中于强强联合的上层社会，以至于预备校一直被看作是特权阶层专属，毕竟家世显赫的学生囊括了大部分入校名额。也正因如此，预备校的老师们从不干涉学生的任何行为——无需他们插手，家长们会第一时间出手管束。预备校相当于一个微缩社会，聚集众多官僚与富商后代，很少有家长会任由孩子在外丢人。贺蔚这次因父亲的升迁而回到首都，上周正式通过预备校考核，但一直没来上课。迄今为止，贺少爷已经替他的联盟中央银行行长父亲在外丢了五天的脸——这都没被家里抓起来，也算个奇迹。“确实，毕竟我又不是那个顾昀迟，不能像顾少爷一样一星期逃课五天。”贺蔚耸耸肩，“我最近到处逛了逛，吃完饭一块儿去玩。”陆赫扬没有明确拒绝，只说：“我爸今天回来。”“嘶——”贺蔚倒吸口气，扭头看他，“那算了，吃了饭就送你回去，麻烦你代我向尊敬的联盟理事长问好。”“一定。”陆赫扬淡笑着说。贺蔚正要收回目光，忽而又望向路边，看了几秒，他抬抬下巴，问：“那个alpha也是我们学校的？”陆赫扬睁开眼，顺着他的视线侧头看过去。非机动车道上，穿校服的alpha正骑着一辆旧单车，后背弓起，晚风灌满他的上衣，吹出鼓胀的弧度，被夕阳照成一座金色山丘。他骑的那辆单车实在是过于破旧，在周遭来往的豪车中格格不入，难怪贺蔚一眼发现。“预备校里还有这么节俭的alpha？”贺蔚笑了声，“有点意思，你认识吗？”那道白皙的左侧脸，陆赫扬隐约有印象。在看清alpha手臂上的淤青时，他联想起十几分钟前教学楼天桥上见过的，似乎是姓许……具体叫什么，他当时没注意听。“不认识。”陆赫扬转回头，再次闭上眼，“没时间留意不相干的人。”
content_en:
Written at the front: The early stage is about campus, but it is very empty and does not talk about study. Overall, it is [slow-burning] + [pretending to be B] + [Mary Sue] + [unrealistic]; one-way crush, bloody, clichéd plot without brains and logic, and bugs everywhere. It is not recommended for those who have requirements for writing and plot.-The last class before school, the sunset enveloped the entire school, and there were at least twenty classes on the playground taking physical education classes.The swings of badminton and tennis rackets startled the birds in the trees. Swallows and sparrows flew up, circled in the air, and then landed in their original places, refusing to return to their nests.Chi Jiahan ran forward in a hurry. The omega was a little weak. After sprinting across half of the playground, he couldn't help but start breathing heavily.When he arrived at the door of the equipment room, he pushed it up. The ajar door swung inward, and a smell of rubber and lime powder hit his face.The equipment room is very spacious. Under the high window at the end, Alpha is sitting on a military green cushion with a pen and a few books stacked on his lap.The afterglow outside the window cast an oblique light on him, revealing patches of black and blue on his arms.The alpha raised his head and watched Chi Jiahan walk up to him."I knew you were here." Chi Jiahan gasped. When he saw the swollen right side of his face and the purple bruises at the corner of his mouth, he frowned, "Weren't they all shot on Friday? Yesterday was only Thursday, so it was early?" "Yes." The alpha responded briefly and lowered his head to read."Xu Ze." Chi Jiahan called him in a deep voice.Xu Ze paused, then put the book aside, stretched out his hand to pull up the hem of his school uniform, revealing a patch of gauze on his right ribs, and said in a calm tone: "It's just here, there are no other injuries." The gauze was very rough, messy and uneven, and it looked like it was made by his own hand, and it was extremely sloppy.Chi Jiahan squatted down, gently pulled the corner of the gauze, and pulled it away. He vaguely saw the densely packed small wounds inside, which had formed into blood scabs and were coagulated messily with the gauze. It was in line with Xu Ze's usual style - he simply and roughly pressed the gauze onto the wound, as if he didn't care how painful it would be to pull it off when changing the dressing."Broken glass?" Chi Jiahan asked with a frown.Xu Ze did not answer directly, only said: "They like to watch." "They also like to watch bare-handed swordsmanship, why don't you try it?" "Knives cannot be brought on stage." Xu Ze replied a little seriously, and put down his clothes.Chi Jiahan sat back on the ground and stared at him coldly for a long time before saying, "Go to the hospital after school." "It's okay, just apply some iodine." As he spoke, Xu Ze put the books in order.The bell rang, and Xu Ze stood up. His movements involved his wound, and he frowned slightly.He stretched out his hand towards Chi Jiahan, but the omega blocked it angrily. Chi Jiahan stood up and patted the dust on his pants.The two walked out of the equipment room. The weather forecast said it would rain at night, and the wind was already a bit cold.On the third floor, people were coming and going on the overpass between the two teaching buildings. Halfway there, Xu Ze suddenly turned his head and looked outside the railing.The wind got stronger, and several alphas came towards me. One of them was especially tall, with a cold face, and he was looking at his mobile phone with his eyes lowered, but somehow - even with his head lowered, people could notice him at a glance.The alpha next to him knew Chi Jiahan and raised his hand to say hello: "Jiahan." Chi Jiahan waved to him as a response.The greeting was brief, but the chat among the alphas was interrupted for a few seconds. The rest of the people looked at Chi Jiahan and Xu Ze, and the alpha who was looking at his phone also raised his head.From their point of view, Xu Ze was half a head taller than Chi Jiahan and was facing the other side.The wind blew the hair on his forehead, and Xu Ze's face was expressionless, looking a little cold and gloomy, but the bruises on his arms were very dazzling, and the short-sleeved school uniform could not block them at all.As they passed each other, the alpha gently bumped into the person next to him who only looked up and then turned his gaze back to the phone screen, and said: "He Yang, the alpha next to Jia Han, Xu Ze, also has an S pheromone level." Lu Heyang turned off the phone and put it in the pocket of his school pants. He didn't actually see anything clearly just now, he just raised his head symbolically.But he still smiled and said, "Really?"

The Alphas walked away behind them, and Xu Ze still kept looking to the right. In fact, his eyes had always been empty, with no specific destination, but now he wanted to look back - this idea was quickly stopped.Xu Ze turned his head and looked straight ahead again, calmly exposing his swollen right face and the purple corner of his mouth to the sight of everyone who came towards him.At the school gate, Lu Heyang said goodbye to several other alphas and stood under the tree on the roadside.Two minutes later, a convertible sports car with a completely black interior and a pink interior stopped neatly in front of him. The alpha in the driver's seat, wearing a T-shirt and sunglasses as if he was returning from a tropical vacation, whistled to him: "Master Lu, long time no see." "If you are absent from school without excuse for more than a week, you will be expelled." Lu Heyang lowered his eyes and tilted his head slightly to remind him.He Wei took off his sunglasses and threw them on the center console, raised his peach blossom eyes, and smiled cynically: "That's great." The passenger door slowly lifted, Lu Heyang sat in, and fastened his seat belt.Like He Wei, he took the driver's license test as soon as he reached the age of 16, but Lu Heyang had no interest in driving to school. He Wei once commented that he had this idea because he relied too much on his family driver.It was time for school to end, and the road was crowded. He Wei drove slowly, glanced at the bracelet on Lu Heyang's wrist, and said softly: "Can't students in the preparatory school take off their bracelets after school?" Alpha's bracelet and Omega's neck ring can suppress and isolate pheromones according to the gear.One of the school rules of the preparatory school is that they must be worn during school to prevent the pheromones from conflicting with each other. Therefore, it is inevitable that the AOs will feel the discomfort of being suppressed and confined to a certain extent."Where to go?" Lu Heyang asked without answering."Eat first." As the car passed the school gate, He Wei looked at the huge white stone carving of the school sign and sighed, "I heard that going to a preparatory school is like going to jail." "It's okay." Lu Heyang adjusted the position of his bracelet to release pheromones appropriately, then he sank back into the seat and closed his eyes, "Let's see how you feel about it." Anyway, for He Wei, studying anywhere is like going to jail."Then I'd better wait for the notice of withdrawal." He Wei said.Lu Heyang smiled: "You should be escorted to school next Monday." The prep school is committed to cultivating top military, political, economic, and medical talents for the alliance. The basic conditions for entering the school are that the pheromone level reaches A level or above, and you need to pass specific written and physical assessments.There are more than 30,000 people in the school's junior high school and high school, among which there are only about 200 students with S-level pheromones.After generations of screening and precipitation, the descendants of high-level pheromones are basically concentrated in the powerful upper class society, so that preparatory schools have always been regarded as exclusive to the privileged class. After all, students with prominent family backgrounds have occupied most of the places in the school.Because of this, the teachers at the preparatory school never interfere with any behavior of the students - without their intervention, the parents will take action as soon as possible.Preparatory schools are equivalent to a micro-society, where many descendants of bureaucrats and wealthy businessmen gather, and few parents would allow their children to be embarrassed outside.He Wei returned to the capital this time because of his father's promotion. He officially passed the preparatory school assessment last week, but he has never come to class.So far, Master He has been humiliating his father, the governor of the Central Bank of the Alliance, for five days - and it is a miracle that he has not been arrested by his family."Indeed, after all, I'm not that Gu Yunchi, so I can't skip classes five days a week like Master Gu." He Wei shrugged, "I've been shopping around recently, and we'll play together after dinner." Lu Heyang didn't explicitly refuse, and just said: "My dad is back today." "Hiss—" He Wei took a breath and turned to look at him, "Forget it, I'll take you back after dinner. Please say hello to the respected chairman of the alliance for me." "Definitely." Lu Heyang said with a faint smile.He Wei was about to retract his gaze when he suddenly looked towards the roadside. After looking at it for a few seconds, he raised his chin and asked, "Is that alpha also from our school?" Lu Heyang opened his eyes and looked sideways along his line of sight.On the non-motorized road, Alpha in school uniform was riding an old bicycle, his back arched, and the evening wind filled his top, causing it to bulge and turn into a golden hill illuminated by the setting sun.The bicycle he was riding was too old and out of place among the luxury cars passing around him. No wonder He Wei noticed it at a glance."Is there such a frugal alpha in the prep school?" He Wei laughed, "It's interesting, do you recognize him?" Lu Heyang had a vague impression of the fair left side of his face.When he saw the bruises on the alpha's arm clearly, he thought of the one he had seen on the overpass of the teaching building ten minutes ago. It seemed that his surname was Xu... What was his specific name? He didn't pay attention at the time."I don't know." Lu Heyang turned his head and closed his eyes again, "I don't have time to pay attention to irrelevant people."
title_en: Recommended popular novels that have been completed
content_zh:
写在最前面：前期校园，但架得很空，不谈学习，总体【慢热】+【装B】+【玛丽苏】+【不现实】；单向暗恋，有狗血，情节俗套无脑无逻辑bug齐飞，对文笔和剧情有要求的不建议看。-放学前最后一节课，夕阳笼罩整个学校，操场上至少有二十几个班级在上体育课。羽毛球拍和网球球拍挥动时惊动树间的鸟群，燕子麻雀扑棱着飞腾起来，在半空绕个圈，又纷纷降落原位，不肯归巢。池嘉寒行色匆匆往前跑，omega体力稍弱，疾跑穿过半个操场后就忍不住开始大口喘气。到了器材室门口，他一把推上去，虚掩的门朝里旋转，一股橡胶和石灰粉的味道扑面而来。器材室很宽敞，尽头高窗下，alpha正拿着笔坐在一块军绿色软垫上，膝上叠着几本书。窗外的余晖斜斜投在他身上，照出一双手臂上成片的乌青。alpha抬起头，看着池嘉寒走到自己面前。“就知道你在这儿。”池嘉寒喘着气，在看见对方肿起的右脸和嘴角的紫红淤血时，他紧拧起眉，“不都是周五打的吗，昨天才星期四，提前了？”“嗯。”alpha简短地应一声，又低下头看书。“许则。”池嘉寒沉声叫他。许则顿了顿，这才把书放到一边，伸手拉起校服下摆，露出右侧肋骨上一块贴着纱布的部位，语气平淡：“就这里，没别的伤了。”纱布贴得很粗糙，杂乱不平整，一看就是出自他自己之手，潦草到不行。池嘉寒蹲下去，轻扯着纱布一角，拉开，隐约看见里面密密麻麻的小伤口，已经结成一粒粒血痂，乱七八糟地和纱布凝固在一起，很符合许则的一贯作风——简单粗暴地把纱布往伤口上摁，好像不在乎换药时扯下来会有多痛。“碎玻璃？”池嘉寒蹙着眉问。许则没有正面回答，只说：“他们喜欢看。”“他们还喜欢看空手接白刃，你要不试试？”“刀具不能带上台。”许则有点认真地答道，顺手把衣摆放下去。池嘉寒往后坐在地上，冷冷瞪他半晌，才说：“放学去医院。”“没事，涂点碘伏就可以。”说话间，许则把书整理好。下课铃响了，许则站起身，动作牵扯到伤口，他轻微皱了皱眉。他朝池嘉寒伸出手，却被omega负气地挡开，池嘉寒自己站起来，拍拍裤子上的灰尘。两人走出器材室，天气预报说晚上会下雨，现在的风已经有点凉。上了三楼，两栋教学楼之间的天桥上人来人往，走到一半，许则忽然扭过头，看向栏杆外。风更大了，迎面走来几个alpha，其中一个尤其高些，面容冷淡，正垂眼看手机，但莫名的——哪怕低着头也能让人一眼就注意到他。他身旁的alpha和池嘉寒认识，抬手打了个招呼：“嘉寒。”池嘉寒朝他挥挥手，当是回应。招呼很简短，但alpha们的聊天还是因此被打断了几秒，其余人纷纷看向池嘉寒和许则这边，连同那个正在看手机的alpha，也抬起了头。从他们的角度看过去，许则比池嘉寒高半个头，正侧着脸朝向另一边。风吹起他额前的发，许则脸上没什么表情，显得有些冷漠阴郁，但手臂上的淤青很是扎眼，短袖校服完全挡不住。互相擦肩而过，alpha轻轻撞了下身边只抬头看了一眼就又把视线移回手机屏幕上的人，说：“赫扬，嘉寒旁边那个alpha，许则，信息素等级也是s。”陆赫扬关了手机放进校裤口袋里，他刚刚其实并没有看清什么，只是象征性抬一眼而已。不过他还是笑了笑，说：“是吗。”

Alpha们在身后走远，许则仍保持着往右看的姿势，实际上他的目光一直是空的，没有具体的落脚点，但他现在想回头看一眼——这个念头很快被打住。许则转回头重新看向正前方，将自己肿起的右脸和青紫的嘴角平静地暴露在每一个迎面而来的人的视线里。校门口，陆赫扬和其他几个alpha道了别，站在路边树下。两分钟后，一辆通体漆黑内饰全粉的敞篷跑车干脆利落地刹在他面前，驾驶座上穿T恤戴墨镜仿佛正从热带度假回来的alpha朝他吹了声口哨：“陆公子，好久不见。”“超过一周无故旷课，会被退学。”陆赫扬垂眼微微歪着头，提醒他。贺蔚摘下墨镜扔到中控台上，弯起一双桃花眼，笑得玩世不恭：“那可太好了。”副驾驶车门缓缓抬起，陆赫扬坐进去，系上安全带。他和贺蔚一样，16岁一到年龄就考了驾照，但陆赫扬对开车上学没什么兴趣，贺蔚曾评价他有这种想法是因为太过依赖家里的司机。正值放学时间，路上挤，贺蔚慢悠悠开着车，瞥了眼陆赫扬腕上的手环，轻啧一声：“预备校的学生放学了也不能摘手环吗？”Alpha的手环、omega的颈环，能够根据档位抑制与隔绝信息素。预备校的校规之一是在校期间必须佩戴，以防信息素相互冲突，因此难免会在一定程度上使得AO们感到被压制与禁锢的不适。“去哪。”陆赫扬不答反问。“先吃个饭。”车子驶过校门，贺蔚看向那块气派的巨大白石雕校牌，叹了口气，“听说读预备校就跟坐牢一样。”“还好。”陆赫扬调整了手环档位，适当释放出信息素，接着整个人往后陷进座椅里，闭上眼，“看你自觉。”反正对贺蔚来说，不管在哪里读书都像坐牢。“那我还是等退学通知好了。”贺蔚说。陆赫扬却笑：“你下周一应该会被押着来学校。”预备校致力于为联盟培养顶尖军事、政经、医学人才，进校的基础条件是信息素等级达到A级及以上，并且需要通过特定的书面和体能考核。全校初中部加高中部共三万多人，其中信息素为s级的学生数量只有两百左右。经过一代代的筛选与沉淀，高等级信息素后代们基本集中于强强联合的上层社会，以至于预备校一直被看作是特权阶层专属，毕竟家世显赫的学生囊括了大部分入校名额。也正因如此，预备校的老师们从不干涉学生的任何行为——无需他们插手，家长们会第一时间出手管束。预备校相当于一个微缩社会，聚集众多官僚与富商后代，很少有家长会任由孩子在外丢人。贺蔚这次因父亲的升迁而回到首都，上周正式通过预备校考核，但一直没来上课。迄今为止，贺少爷已经替他的联盟中央银行行长父亲在外丢了五天的脸——这都没被家里抓起来，也算个奇迹。“确实，毕竟我又不是那个顾昀迟，不能像顾少爷一样一星期逃课五天。”贺蔚耸耸肩，“我最近到处逛了逛，吃完饭一块儿去玩。”陆赫扬没有明确拒绝，只说：“我爸今天回来。”“嘶——”贺蔚倒吸口气，扭头看他，“那算了，吃了饭就送你回去，麻烦你代我向尊敬的联盟理事长问好。”“一定。”陆赫扬淡笑着说。贺蔚正要收回目光，忽而又望向路边，看了几秒，他抬抬下巴，问：“那个alpha也是我们学校的？”陆赫扬睁开眼，顺着他的视线侧头看过去。非机动车道上，穿校服的alpha正骑着一辆旧单车，后背弓起，晚风灌满他的上衣，吹出鼓胀的弧度，被夕阳照成一座金色山丘。他骑的那辆单车实在是过于破旧，在周遭来往的豪车中格格不入，难怪贺蔚一眼发现。“预备校里还有这么节俭的alpha？”贺蔚笑了声，“有点意思，你认识吗？”那道白皙的左侧脸，陆赫扬隐约有印象。在看清alpha手臂上的淤青时，他联想起十几分钟前教学楼天桥上见过的，似乎是姓许……具体叫什么，他当时没注意听。“不认识。”陆赫扬转回头，再次闭上眼，“没时间留意不相干的人。”
